searchText: Hi grandine team, I'm running devnets with the new devnet-6 branch, and I noticed that data column sidecar verification requests sometimes surge a lot: http://94.130.19.237:3000/d/dsfasdfasf/network-monitor?orgId=1&from=2025-04-13T17:20:54.214Z&to=2025-04-13T22:44:46.740Z&timezone=utc&var-network=peerdas-devnet-ssl-15&var-consensus=$__all&var-execution=$__all&refresh=1m&editPanel=63 (from <1-2000 to 3 million) At this time, grandine restarts due to stack overflow(https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1252403418941624532/1359508533099495556), and starts to sync back up to head. It seems, while trying to sync to head and get the blobs, it sends a lot of requests data column verification/processing. Higher request while syncing seems okay, but 3 million seems too high. I attached the log for that period as well. Hi grandine team, I'm running devnets I've also sent small changes to [prysm](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/15168) and [geth](https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/go-ethereum/pull/64) for fixing getBlobsV2 payload naming. I think it wasn't working on the devnet-6 right now but will with this change lighthouse-reth-3 bug lots of nimbus missed/orphaned blocks prysm-nethermind-9 bug grandine-reth nodes are all offline https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1441 ICYMI: Feel free to DM me or comment on the issue, if there are any items you would like added. <@785811170387951616> and everyone else reminder that devnet 5 is going down today EOD. Please yell if you want it up still . Okay pls come with opinions on how you want the BPO config to look tomorrow on the call: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1441#issuecomment-2801949912 thread with options: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1360267444911865876 And: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1360292816235925605
